description: This PHP source file defines the 'UserDao' class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for data access operations related to user management. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching user entities, as well as handling user roles and employee associations.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for interacting with User entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, user validation, role management, and search functionality within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a User entity to the database and returns the persisted User.

methods.name: isExistingSystemUser
methods.description: Checks if a user with the given credentials exists and is active.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingSystemUserIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing users from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs of all non-deleted system users.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on users by setting their 'deleted' flag to true.

methods.name: getAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves user roles that are marked as assignable.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a user role entity by its name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of users matching specified search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a search query for users based on specified filters and returns matching User entities.

methods.name: getSearchUserPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for user search queries based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: isUserNameExistByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists in the system, excluding a specified user ID if provided.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by username.

methods.name: getDefaultAdminUser
methods.description: Fetches the default admin user, typically the initial superuser with no creator and a set password.
